items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: Benny Goodman needs a trumpet player... can you leave tomorrow for the road? ... So I leave, so I get to the gig

ctx.x: You know that’s got to — © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

The other thing is, those stories which are in my heart. The first time — I get a call from John Bunch, he says Benny Goodman needs a trumpet player can you come down to the Astor Hotel right away? I says sure. So I pack up my horn and I go down to the Astor Hotel, I walk in and there’s Benny, Buddy Tate, John Bunch, Connie Kaye, and who’s the bass player?
